// NEGATIVE fixture — `structuredClone` only where a lexer must not see it.
// A line comment: structuredClone(value)
/* A block comment: structuredClone(value) */
const SINGLE = 'structuredClone(value)';
const DOUBLE = "structuredClone(value)";
const TEMPLATE = `JSON round-trip instead, never structuredClone(value)`;
const IN_REGEX = /\bstructuredClone\b/;

export function mentionsStructuredClone(source) {
  return /\bstructuredClone\b/.test(source);
}

export function copy(value) {
  // Near-miss in real code: the word boundary does not fire inside `structuredCloneShim`.
  const shim = value && value.structuredCloneShim;
  void shim;
  return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value));
}

export { SINGLE, DOUBLE, TEMPLATE, IN_REGEX };
